title: Abbas madad ko
body:
maqtal mein kaha sheh ne ro kar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha uthe laashe akbar
abbas madad ko aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
saahil se chale aao bhaiya
uthwao bhatije ka laasha
hai seena e akbar mein naiza
har samt andhera hai chaaya
be-noor hai aankhein tooti kamar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se ani jo hai khaynchi
mai kaise bataun kya guzri
hamshakle nabi reti pe gira
to rone lage khud pyare nabi
khud dekhlo maqtal mein aa kar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
kayi baar gira is manzil mein
akbar tak pahuncha mushkil mein
jo seena e akbar mein hai laga
wo naiza hai mere dil mein
hai door hua mujhse dilbar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab dekha akbar ka chehra
yaad aaye mujhe mere nana
kis tarha sambhalun mai dil ko
reti pe tadapta hai laasha
khoon mein hai shabihe paighambar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
sughra se kiya tha jo waada
wo waada akbar toot gaya
ab sochta hoon kya bolunga
jab khat aayega sughra ka
tooti hai qayamat ab mujh par
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
nau laakh ke lashkar ne mere
bete ko ghayr ke maara hai
ummat ye bhool gayi lekin
ye mursal ka aaeena hai
chalta hai mere dil par khanjar
abbas madad ko aajao...
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt bapa ek mehshar tha
jab khoon mein ghaltan akbar tha
ek nauha sheh ke lab par tha
yazdan wo kaisa manzar tha
sheh kehte thay ro ro kar asgher
abbas madad ko aajao...
author: Syed Asgher Ali
